connectivity_check_hint: A read-only 'SELECT 1' (SQL) or ping/status command (Mongo/Redis) is enough to confirm connectivity — never run anything that writes, and never print the resolved credential/password into a report or evidence file, only host + db name.
usage: Run these against config/env files and the backend's dependency manifest (requirements.txt/package.json/pom.xml) to identify DB technology before Level 1's backend.database check. Record the result in smoke-state.json under discovery.stack.database. This complements patterns/backend.json (framework detection) and patterns/configuration.json (host/port mismatch) — together they tell you what to connect to and how before you try connecting.
